URL: https://www.independent.ie/business/world/pound-steady-and-uk-gilts-edge-higher-as-john-healey-named-new-chancellor/a/159026828.html
NOTE: Reuters (21 Jul) — Sterling steady, gilts recovered some ground after Healey named Chancellor; investors await fiscal signals. Pound ~$1.34, ~85p vs euro. 10-year gilt yield dipped 1.5bps to 5.01% (after jumping 8bps above 5% Monday); rose to ~5.05% mid-July, highest since 20 May. 30-year -1.5bps to 5.73%. UK public borrowing fell to £16bn in June (stronger tax receipts, lower inflation-linked debt payments). Analysts: latest data positive — BoE may have room to ease over next year. Next MPC decision 30 July (hold at 3.75% expected).
